WAN_JIE_RU_LIN_GHOST_QI.description:
Wan Jie Ru Lin's secondary resource, similar to [gold]Stars[/gold]: it is independent of Energy and is spent to pay the cost of certain cards.
It is kept between turns within a combat, but resets to [blue]1[/blue] when a new combat begins, and does not refill automatically at the start of each turn.
